title: WaVeFuse: Regime-Adaptive Equity Index Forecasting via Channel-Wise Wavelet Denoising and Vertical Attention Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.14733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid Deep Learning for equity index forecasting is limited by three problems: propagation of OHLCV noise into derived technical indicators (TIs), channel-indiscriminate multi-scale decomposition that conflates heterogeneous frequency signatures, and static multi-branch fusion that cannot adapt to market regime shifts. WaVeFuse addresses these limitations through a unified dual-branch architecture. Symlet-4 wavelet denoising (level 2, MAD soft threshold) suppresses microstructure noise in OHLCV. Seven low-lag TIs computed from denoised prices are encoded by a causal channel-wise continuous wavelet transform (Morlet, 32 scales) into a per-timestep scale-space matrix. translated_title: WaVeFuse：通过逐通道小波去噪与垂直注意力融合实现市场状态自适应的股指指数预测
translated_abstract: 混合深度学习用于股指指数预测受到三个问题的限制：OHLCV（开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价、成交量）中的噪声会传播到衍生技术指标（TIs）中、无视通道差异的多尺度分解会混淆异构的频率特征，以及静态的多分支融合无法适应市场状态的转变。WaVeFuse通过统一的双分支架构解决了这些局限性。Symlet-4小波去噪（2层分解，MAD软阈值）抑制OHLCV中的微观结构噪声。由去噪后价格计算出的七个低滞后技术指标通过因果逐通道连续小波变换（Morlet小波，32个尺度）被编码为逐时间步的尺度-空间矩阵。CNN-BiLSTM分支捕获时间动态特性，而双层Transformer（头数=4，dk ∈ {16, 32}）建模跨尺度的频谱依赖关系，二者的表示通过一个2-token softmax门控的垂直注意力融合机制进行整合，该机制能够动态地对分支的权重进行重新加权……
tldr: WaVeFuse提出了一种双分支深度学习架构，通过Symlet-4小波去噪消除OHLCV微观结构噪声、利用逐通道连续小波变换与CNN-BiLSTM及Transformer分别建模时间动态和跨尺度频谱依赖，并以垂直注意力融合机制动态调整分支权重，实现了能自适应市场状态变化的股指指数预测。
en_tdlr: WaVeFuse introduces a unified dual-branch architecture that suppresses OHLCV microstructure noise via Symlet-4 wavelet denoising, models temporal dynamics and inter-scale spectral dependencies with CNN-BiLSTM and Transformer respectively, and dynamically reweights branches through Vertical Attention Fusion to achieve regime-adaptive equity index forecasting.
